_: Every colour the renderer uses. Swap these to restyle the whole scene.
_levels: Day activity, quiet -> busiest. Index = contributionLevel (0-4).
_sky: Vertical gradient per mood. The mood comes from yesterday's activity.
_panel: Card the year's squares sit on, so empty days still read as days.
_ground: Sea the creature walks on, top -> bottom.
_chars: Sprite characters. '.' is transparent and is not listed here.
